name: Spellcasting
description: You can cast Paladin spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. You have 2 prepared level-1 spells; whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared spell with another Paladin spell. You can use a Holy Symbol as your spellcasting focus.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Your training allows you to use the mastery property of 2 weapons you are proficient with. You can change which weapons you use this with after a Long Rest. See Weapon Mastery cards for property details.
